summary: Neri bounty case state: orient, open with a frozen start record, gate-checked stage moves (ready also makes the HackerOne draft), owner asks, ranked programs with scope, drift check.

help:
Usage: neri [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Neri bug bounty case state

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  next     Holds, asks, open cases, top programs
  show     Case card or program
  new      Start a case and freeze its hunt-start record
  advance  Move a case one stage.
  log      Log a history line
  ask      Ask the owner
  check    Find state/file drift
  program  Program policy
help.next:
Usage: neri next [OPTIONS]

  Holds, asks, open cases, top programs

Options:
  --needs HUNT  source|lab|big-lab|live
  --json
  --help        Show this message and exit.
help.show:
Usage: neri show [OPTIONS] {subject}

  Case card or program

Arguments:
  subject  [required]

Options:
  --events <int range>  [default: 5; x>=1]
  --json
  --help                Show this message and exit.
help.new:
Usage: neri new [OPTIONS] {PROGRAM} {slug}

  Start a case and freeze its hunt-start record

Arguments:
  PROGRAM  [required]
  slug     [required]

Options:
  --asset <str>     scope row it targets
  --class <str>     bug class, e.g. CWE-285
  --hunt KIND       source|lab|big-lab|live
  --searched <str>  public same-class search and result
  --version <str>   target version or commit
  --cost <str>      cost estimate
  --lineage <str>   earlier case, same finding
  --label <str>
  --json
  --help            Show this message and exit.
help.advance:
Usage: neri advance [OPTIONS] {CASE} {STAGE}

  Move a case one stage.

  STAGE: hunting|candidate|replayed|reviewed|ready|submitted|closed|killed

Arguments:
  CASE   [required]
  STAGE  [required]

Options:
  --dry-run
  --reason <str>
  --take
  --outcome OUTCOME   accepted|duplicate|informative|not_applicable|paid
  --amount <str>
  --currency <str>    [default: USD]
  --submission <str>
  --ack <str>
  --json
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.log:
Usage: neri log [OPTIONS] {CASE} {text}

  Log a history line

Arguments:
  CASE  [required]
  text  [required]

Options:
  --next <str>     next step; - clears
  --program <str>
  --release
  --peak <str>     mem=5.2G,cpu=1.5[,hunt=KIND]
  --take
  --json
  --help           Show this message and exit.
help.ask:
Usage: neri ask [OPTIONS] {subject} {title}

  Ask the owner

Arguments:
  subject  [required]
  title    [required]

Options:
  --kind KIND     approve|submit|decide|setup  [required]
  --detail <str>
  --json
  --help          Show this message and exit.
help.check:
Usage: neri check [OPTIONS] [CASE]

  Find state/file drift

Arguments:
  [CASE]

Options:
  --all
  --json
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.program:
Usage: neri program [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Program policy

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list     Programs, ranked, with a why line
  show     One program
  refresh  Read program records from the platform API
  set      Record judgment and ratings; identity; observed fields on...
help.program list:
Usage: neri program list [OPTIONS]

  Programs, ranked, with a why line

Options:
  --json
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.program show:
Usage: neri program show [OPTIONS] {PROGRAM}

  One program

Arguments:
  PROGRAM  [required]

Options:
  --json
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.program refresh:
Usage: neri program refresh [OPTIONS] [PROGRAM]

  Read program records from the platform API

Arguments:
  [PROGRAM]

Options:
  --key <str>
  --all
  --json
  --help       Show this message and exit.
help.program set:
Usage: neri program set [OPTIONS] {PROGRAM}

  Record judgment and ratings; identity; observed fields on manual platforms

Arguments:
  PROGRAM  [required]

Options:
  --verdict VERDICT  go|open|no-go
  --evidence <str>
  --gate GATE        G1|G2|G3
  --recheck <str>
  --proof MODE       self-hosted|live|source-only
  --g3 <int range>   [0<=x<=3]
  --dup <int range>  [0<=x<=3]
  --lab <int range>  [0<=x<=3]
  --platform <str>
  --name <str>
  --handle <str>
  --state <str>      open|paused|suspended|closed
  --pays <str>       target-class max, e.g. 5000
  --currency <str>
  --avg-paid <str>
  --scope <str>      in|out KIND ASSET
  --json
  --help             Show this message and exit.

usage.when: start of a Neri session, and after an owner answer
usage.why: one call: cases you hold, answered asks, stale items, top open cases, top ranked programs
precautions: read-only
--needs prints only the placement needs for that hunt kind

usage.when: before working a case, or to read a program
usage.why: stage, gates met and missing for the next stage, last events (default 5, with import notes), file paths
precautions: read-only; gate output skips the secret scan

usage.cmd: st neri new <program> <slug> --asset A --class C --hunt KIND --searched TEXT
usage.when: starting a case; slug is yyyy-mm-dd-name
usage.why: copies findings/_template, adds the case row, claims it, freezes the start record
precautions: optional --version, --cost, --lineage (an earlier case of the same finding), --label
rerun is a no-op; label is generic: no target or evidence

usage.when: a stage's files are done; --dry-run lists what is missing
usage.why: checks the gates against the case files, moves the stage, sends the alert once
precautions: one step; killed, or hunting from candidate on, needs --reason
same stage again: resend failed alerts; ready/submitted/closed re-gate
ready opens the owner's submit ask and the HackerOne draft
replay and review need a session unlike the finder's; --take claims a stale case

usage.when: a fact, decision or dead end worth keeping in the case history
usage.why: timestamped history line; keeps your claim alive
precautions: 240 characters max; details stay in notes.md
--next sets the next step ('-' clears); --program sets the program
--release drops your hold; killed or closed cases take none
--peak mem=5.2G,cpu=1.5[,hunt=lab] records a measured peak for hunt needs

usage.when: the owner must decide, approve, submit or set something up
usage.why: shows on the owner page; the answer comes back in `st neri next`
precautions: title 200 characters, --detail 400
generic wording: no target or evidence

usage.when: before committing in Neri Hunters, or when a case looks off
usage.why: finds stage vs files drift, report edits after the handoff commit, stale holders, failed alerts
precautions: read-only; exits 1 on errors only
no argument: warnings as counts by kind; a case or --all lists each

usage.when: choosing where to hunt, or finding stale policy checks
usage.why: ranked programs first with a why line, then gated and untriaged ones; unknowns say unknown
precautions: read-only; rank is worked out on read, never stored

usage.when: reading a program's verdict, gate, recheck and cases
usage.why: shortlist row plus cases; same as st neri show <program>
precautions: read-only

usage.when: a policy needs a current check (candidate and ready gates need one); --all weekly
usage.why: the only writer of observed fields and scope rows on API platforms; before/after event
precautions: signed-out network read through queue_tool.py

stamps checked only when the policy fingerprint is unchanged; on a change, update programs/

.md

usage.cmd: st neri program set <program> [--verdict V --gate G --recheck T] [--g3 --dup --lab N] --evidence TEXT
usage.when: a verdict settles or changes, or ratings (0-3, scale in policy.json) need setting
usage.why: judgment, ratings with rater, identity; each change is a before/after event
precautions: evidence: primary-source URL and UTC date, 240 chars
manual platforms only: --state --pays --currency --avg-paid --scope 'in|out KIND ASSET'
